cosec cot Identity, Class 10 board exam: prove (cosec θ − cot θ)² = (1 − cos θ)/(1 + cos θ).

• Write cosec θ = 1/sin θ and cot θ = cos θ/sin θ
• LHS = (1 − cos θ)²/sin²θ
• sin²θ = 1 − cos²θ = (1 − cos θ)(1 + cos θ)
• Cancel (1 − cos θ): LHS = (1 − cos θ)/(1 + cos θ) = RHS
